description: This file manages shared Matrix client instances, including creation, state management, starting/stopping clients, and handling crypto initialization.

methods.name: loadMatrixCreateClientDeps
methods.description: Loads dependencies for creating a Matrix client asynchronously.

methods.name: buildSharedClientKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key for identifying shared Matrix clients based on auth parameters.

methods.name: createSharedMatrixClient
methods.description: Creates a new shared Matrix client with specified authentication and configuration.

methods.name: findSharedClientStateByInstance
methods.description: Finds the shared client state associated with a given MatrixClient instance.

methods.name: deleteSharedClientState
methods.description: Removes a shared client state from internal maps.

methods.name: ensureSharedClientStarted
methods.description: Ensures that a shared Matrix client is started, initializing crypto if needed.

methods.name: resolveSharedMatrixClientState
methods.description: Resolves or creates a shared Matrix client state based on parameters.
